items.title: Norris Turney interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: I think I heard Artie Shaw’s band when he had Billie Holiday with him.

ctx.x: The swing music of the time that might have been coming through Ohio, did you have a chance to go out and hear any of the bands that you were hearing on the radio?
Well later after I graduated from high school I heard a couple of bands. I think I heard Artie Shaw’s band when he had Billie Holiday with him. And Lionel Hampton. And that’s about it.
